# Track Browser — Post-Implementation Delta

The Awtsmoos renews the work after the work, so success cannot disguise a missing seam;
Awtsmoos.com compares intention with evidence until each remaining shadow enters the beam.

## Planned

- Remove the live runtime track stylesheet factory.
- Preserve historical public render/command/selection/cache exports.
- Replace track `innerHTML`, `.onclick`, and injected styles with safe readable DOM and listeners.
- Split toolbar, controls, and interaction CSS into static route-local modules.
- Preserve selection count, cache saved state, Download-vs-ZIP wording, playlist, cache, bookmark, and play behavior.
- Keep every touched source <=120 lines.
- Add regression contracts and rerun the complete Rebbe suite.
- Collect fresh route-load evidence.

## Actual

- `ensureTrackStyles()` is now a documented compatibility no-op.
- `tracks.js`, `commands.js`, `row.js`, `toolbar.js`, `selection.js`, and `cache.js` were fully rewritten into readable tab-indented factories/controllers.
- Active track rendering no longer uses executable `innerHTML`, `.onclick =`, `style.textContent`, or the historical injected style ID.
- Static track CSS now lives in `track-browser-shell.css`, `track-browser-controls.css`, and `track-browser-interaction.css` and is imported by `runtime-ui.css`.
- All track JS parses and every touched track source is <=116 lines.
- The first semantic readback caught a potential regression before tests: local Select/Add/Playlist actions would have double-fired alongside the generic controller callback.
- `toolbar.js` was fully rewritten again so local actions intentionally omit `onAction`, preserving the old one-owner-per-click semantics while Download/Cache/Save remain controller-owned.
- Two focused regression contracts were added.
- The complete Rebbe test suite passes 9/9.
- `git diff --check -- geelooy/apps/rebbe` passed during the source gate.
- A previous live Rebbe route returned HTTP 200, but the later 8913 preview server died before the post-track route receipt; fresh route proof therefore remains shadow work.

## Delta discovered by success

- `ui/bookshelf.js` is an active candidate containing `document.createElement('style')` plus a compressed `style.textContent` stylesheet.
- Loaded `styles/studio.css` still has raw stacking values including `9999` and is >249 lines, so any Studio touch requires a full modular split rather than a local tweak.
- Loaded `styles/ui.css` still includes a raw `9999` layer; `styles/boot.css` includes `10000`.
- `index.html` still contains inline style ownership for `ctx-menu` and `matrix-bg`, including raw z-index values; do not touch until exact ownership/status is proven because the entry file is large and would require a deliberate modular strategy.
- Historical `style.css` also contains raw layers but is not loaded by the main Rebbe entry and remains out of scope unless another live entry proves it active.

## DELTA

1. Mark Track Browser complete in the durable ledger.
2. Trace Bookshelf import/caller/render/style ownership and Git status.
3. If Bookshelf is live and clean, migrate its runtime style factory to static scoped CSS and modernize its visible DOM safely.
4. Add focused Bookshelf tests and rerun the complete Rebbe suite.
5. Start a fresh isolated server for live route proof after Bookshelf closure.
6. Then open the larger Studio layer/form-control wave with its own three-phase plan.

## NEXT_ACTION

Update REMAINING_WORK, then inspect Bookshelf ownership, source, import graph, line count, and existing CSS contracts before any mutation.
